|game_text=Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Adds 2 to maneuver of any starfighter he pilots. Your total ability here may not be reduced. Once per game, may lose 1 force to deploy a droid from Lost Pile. During battle, target a just hit character. Target's forfeit is restored to normal.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Chewbacca, Walking Carpet]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-02-Chewbacca_Walking_Carpet-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-chewbaccawalkingcarpet-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-02-Chewbacca_Walking_Carpet.png]]) show the original text (see [[Chewbacca, Walking Carpet]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Chewbacca, Walking Carpet]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Adds 2 to maneuver of any starfighter he pilots. Your total ability here may not be reduced. Once per game, may lose 1 Force to deploy a droid from Lost Pile. During battle, may target a just-hit character. Target's forfeit is restored to normal.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-chewbaccawalkingcarpet-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-02-Chewbacca_Walking_Carpet.png]]) print it. (The page had the Decipher lore “Some people think that hokey religions …”; the slip and the Players Committee card image print only “Wookiee scoundrel.”) The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 5) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) wrote the pilot icon out (“Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots.”), changed “lose 1 Force” to “lose 1 force”, dropped “may” (“During battle, target”) and the hyphen (“a just hit character”)<ref name="cl-1281_26-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013</ref>: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Adds 2 to maneuver of any starfighter he pilots. Your total ability here may not be reduced. Once per game, may lose 1 force to deploy a droid from Lost Pile. During battle, target a just hit character. Target's forfeit is restored to normal.” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-02-Chewbacca_Walking_Carpet-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
